mail.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
mail.footer: This email was sent automatically by {siteName}. Please don't reply to it.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email for {siteName}
verifyEmail.body: Click the button below to verify your email. The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn't sign up for {siteName}, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password for {siteName}
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new one. The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
resetPassword.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.

errors.invalid_origin: The request came from an untrusted origin. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.request_too_large: The submitted content is too large.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.registration_disabled: Registration is closed on this site.
errors.email_domain_not_allowed: This site doesn't accept sign-ups from this email domain.
errors.password_too_short: Password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.password_too_long: Password must be at most {max} characters.
errors.nickname_invalid: Nickname must be between {min} and {max} characters.
errors.player_name_invalid: Player name {rule, select, official {can only contain letters, numbers and underscores} cjk {can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, § and Chinese characters} utf8 {cannot contain spaces or other whitespace} other {does not match the rules of this site}}.
errors.player_name_length: Player name must be between {min} and {max} characters.
errors.player_name_taken: This player name is already taken.
errors.player_name_rule_misconfigured: The player name rule on this site is misconfigured. Contact the administrator.
errors.ip_limit_reached: Only {limit} accounts can be registered from the same IP address.
errors.mail_not_configured: This site hasn't set up email delivery, so emails can't be sent right now.
